chapter_seo_title: Little Defiant Dragon and Eve of Departure on Dragon Island
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen encounters a stubborn little dragon that refuses to yield, dragons make a tragic compromise, and survivors gather for the final departure from Dragon Island.
og_title: Little Defiant Dragon and the Eve of Departure
og_description: In this quiet chapter, Xiao Chen observes the dragons' heartbreaking sacrifice and bonds with a small, unyielding dragon that will become his faithful companion.

twitter_description: Xiao Chen finds a strange little dragon that never gives up, as the survivors of Dragon Island prepare to leave for the World of Immortality.
